source_text: נָמ֤וּ רֹעֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ אַדִּירֶ֑י/ךָ נָפֹ֧שׁוּ עַמְּ/ךָ֛ עַל הֶ/הָרִ֖ים וְ/אֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּֽץ־׃
english_snapshot: Your shepherds slumber[a], O king of Assyria; your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains[d][c][b], and there is no one to gather them.

signals.text: The Hebrew behind 'are scattered' is difficult; the sense is supported by the following line, 'there is no one to gather them.'
